description: Compute-only search with selected existing cumulant coefficients frozen, fixed calib0, and an explicit directional/radial mode gene. No truth sampling or fitting.

protocol.initial: Current selected estimator with pruning and adaptive-rank selection disabled; rank_old remains 256.
protocol.mode: Both directional_k4 values are searched, ranked and eligible as SA/GA/hill seeds; False is a comparator, not a fallback.
protocol.fixed_comparisons: Explicit fixed-config batches may override declared fixed kwargs, with all effective kwargs recorded; search seeds must match fixed_kwargs.
protocol.selection: Search only mini0..11; fast8 uses mini0..7. Confirm on development12 and select a small finalist set on mini12..99 (88 records, all historically inspected). Other datasets require explicit source/split/indices and a fixed-config batch; no automatic old final4 use.
protocol.parallel_residual: Recorded only; official residual safety requires a separate single-thread preflight.
